title: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) Imaging of Thrombosis
official: Preliminary Evaluation of [64Cu]FBP8 in Healthy Individuals and Subjects With Known or at Risk of Developing Thrombosis
summary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate a new radiotracer called 64Cu-FBP8 for PET-MR imaging of thrombosis. The tracer has the potential of detecting thrombosis anywhere in the body, for instance in the left atrial appendage of patients with atrial fibrillation, and thereby may provide a non-invasive alternative to the current standard-of-care methods.
